name: Scrambled Red Shakshuka
dish: Eggs softly scrambled into a thick red pepper and tomato sauce, topped with herbed, chile-oil feta. Breakfast or brunch, eaten straight away.

stages.do: stir feta topping together, leave to sit
ingredients: Aleppo chile flakes or red pepper flakes
Coriander seeds, lightly toasted and crushed

stages.do: heat rest of oil, cook onion
ingredients: Yellow or white onion, thinly sliced
Red bell pepper, seeded and cut into long slices
Cumin seeds, lightly toasted and crushed
Coriander seeds, lightly toasted and crushed

stages.do: add both tomatoes, chile paste, water, 1 tsp salt, plenty of pepper; simmer
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
Salt and black pepper to taste

stages.do: pour eggs in slowly while swirling pan, fold gently; then lower heat, lid on
off heat; feta mix over top, last chile flakes; serve at once
